heading: Adapters, storage backends, debugger bridges
text:
### Adapters, storage backends, debugger bridges [RARC.11.6]

None of them is a runtime component. Adapter-engine integration
is the integrator's design (whatever transport, framing, and
connection model fits their stack); storage backends connect via
the cache callbacks; debugger bridges
layer on top of the existing stream callback. See [IARC.1.14]
for the discipline.
